title: Minimum Rounds To Complete All Tasks
statement:
Each task has a difficulty. A round completes exactly two or three tasks of one difficulty. Return the minimum number of rounds needed to complete all tasks, or `-1` if impossible.

## Examples

```text
Input: tasks = [2,2,3,3,2,4,4,4,4,4]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: tasks = [2,3,3]
Output: -1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= tasks.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= tasks[i] <= 10^9`
